Had a tiny delay — Lewisham wanted extra window drawings because it's a conservation area (fair enough!)
Daniel sent the gorgeous window technical drawings on ~24 Feb 2026
Now we're in the 8-week wait — patience is a virtue, babes
Lewisham sometimes runs a teeny bit behind schedule — but that's okay, we're flexible!

nickActions: Ask Daniel for the exact validation date so we can count down properly! 📅

workstreams.name: Building Control 🏗️
workstreams.summary: Daniel is finalising the building control drawings — like, literally any moment now! Once submitted, Lewisham gets 5 working days to accept. Easy peasy! 💅
detail: We chose London Building Control (private AI) at £950+VAT — Nick said yes on 10 Mar 👍
Daniel is on it — instructed to proceed immediately
BC drawings were in final checks on 10 Mar — should be done super soon!
Once submitted: Initial Notice goes to Lewisham (5 working days to accept), then plan check starts
Just FYI — can't start structural works until party wall agreements are signed (but Phase 1 is totally fine!)
workstreams.waitingOn: BC drawings from Daniel — then Lewisham accepts the Initial Notice ✨

workstreams.name: Party Wall 🏘️
workstreams.summary: Okay so this one's a bit of a journey! Lewisham dissented (totally standard, don't stress 💆‍♀️), and appointed Andy Copper as their surveyor. We're trying to get Andy as the agreed surveyor for everyone — much simpler! Two neighbours are a liiittle nervous but we'll work it out 💖
detail: Notices served 25 Feb 2026 — official and proper, just like us 📋✨
Served on Lewisham (they own the freehold of 30A, 30B, 32B) AND the actual neighbours
Lewisham dissented → appointed Andy Copper (Party Wall Works Ltd) — this is normal, don't panic!
9 Mar: Nick asked Lewisham if Andy can be the agreed surveyor instead — saves everyone time and money!
9 Mar: Also asked Andy if he can do the same for the neighbours — manifesting a yes! 🙏
Two neighbours have been spoken to — they want to be involved, which is totally their right 💖
Nick hasn't appointed his own surveyor yet — holding off to see if the agreed route works
workstreams.waitingOn: Andy Copper and Lewisham party wall replies — come on bestie, check your email! 📧
nickActions: If the agreed surveyor thing doesn't work out → appoint Jon Hicks / SSES (from £695+VAT) — he's Lewisham's preferred surveyor so that's a good sign! ⭐

Documents sent: disclaimer, RAMS, insurance, architectural plans, structural plans/sections/spec

Response expected within 10 working days (~25 March 2026) — marked it in the diary! 📅
Key contact: Lianne Holland (Home Ownership Officer) — she's been helpful!
